[[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] '''Yrul Tash''' was an [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]] [[Imperial officer/Legends|officer]] stationed on [[Goroth Prime/Legends|Goroth Prime]]. [[Homeworld/Legends|Hailing]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Jalarren]], which had wide-open spaces, Tash found the confines of the warrens in [[Gorothite/Legends|Gorothite]] [[o'beki]]s to be constricting and unwelcoming.
